title: GTA 6 Standard vs Ultimate Edition: Bonuses and Codes
summary: Compare Rockstar's GTA VI Standard and Ultimate editions, Vintage Vice City Pack, boxed download codes and upgrade options.
intro: GTA VI has more than one edition, and buyers should know which items are included before ordering. Rockstar's support information describes Standard and Ultimate versions, a separately purchasable Ultimate upgrade and a Vintage Vice City promotional pack. The game launches November 19 on supported consoles; this buying guide distinguishes confirmed entitlements from assumptions about physical discs or region compatibility.

sections.heading: Standard Edition provides the main game
paragraphs: Rockstar says the Standard Edition includes Grand Theft Auto VI itself. That is the simplest choice for players whose main goal is to experience Jason and Lucia's story without committing to additional themed items. A higher-priced edition is not a prerequisite for accessing the story described by the publisher.

If an add-on matters later, Rockstar says Standard owners can buy an Ultimate Edition Upgrade through the supported console storefront after the game code is redeemed. Check the actual local storefront pricing and conditions before assuming an early purchase offers better value.

sections.heading: What the Ultimate Edition adds
paragraphs: Rockstar lists the game alongside a package of story-related extras in the Ultimate Edition. Examples in the support documentation include a '95 Grotti Cheetah, revolvers, personalized weapon variants, vehicles associated with Jason's safehouse and several customization locations and collections.

The publisher describes these extras as appearing across chapters of Jason and Lucia's story. That suggests the full package may not be available at the beginning of a fresh playthrough. Avoid misleading posts that imply an Ultimate purchase instantly grants every location or vehicle before normal story progression.

sections.heading: The Vintage Vice City Pack is a separate offer
paragraphs: Rockstar's support FAQ describes a promotional Vintage Vice City Pack with a '55 Vapid Stanier Sedan and garage, outfits, hairstyles and an exclusive weapon pattern. It also mentions one month of GTA+ for eligible digital purchases before November 20, 2026. Read the exact current terms for your edition and account region.

This promotional pack should not be confused with the complete Ultimate Edition Upgrade. A buyer should check whether the desired benefit belongs to the limited-time purchase offer or to the more expensive edition. Screenshots featuring both packages together can obscure that distinction.

sections.heading: Physical packaging does not mean a game disc
paragraphs: The publisher states that GTA VI's physical console package contains a download code, not a disc. That means a network download and valid code redemption remain necessary. Rockstar's FAQ described physical availability from November 12 to support preloading, but retailer collection and shipping timelines can vary.

Before purchasing a box from an unfamiliar marketplace, check whether the retailer and regional code are compatible with your console account. A photograph of packaging alone cannot prove that a code is unused. Buyers should keep receipts and follow the platform's established redemption procedure.

sections.heading: Account regions and code restrictions matter
paragraphs: Rockstar warns that code redemption can depend on the region of the platform account. It recommends buying from a retailer in the country of the account to avoid activation problems. Rules can differ between PlayStation and Xbox products; do not assume a code advertised for one storefront will activate everywhere.

This is especially important for imported physical copies and digital codes offered by resellers. A low advertised price is not useful if the code cannot be redeemed. Check the package region and actual platform before making a payment, and do not share your account password or verification codes to activate a game.

sections.heading: Preload timing and the final purchase checklist
paragraphs: Rockstar's newer November 3 instructions specify November 10 digital preloading, with PlayStation using local midnight and Xbox using 00:00 GMT. Earlier support material can still display November 12 details for other purchase contexts, so the more recent dedicated preload guidance should govern digital downloads.

Decide first whether the Standard game is enough, then compare the Ultimate additions and temporary pack terms. Confirm edition, console platform, account region, download method, available storage and refund conditions. GTA VI is currently listed for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, without a confirmed PC launch date.
